entities.name: EPS bearer context status
entities.description: Information element that indicates the state of each EPS bearer context identifiable by an EPS bearer identity. It is a type 4 information element with 4 octets length.

entities.name: EPS bearer context status IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier field in the EPS bearer context status IE.

entities.name: Length of EPS bearer context status contents
entities.description: Length field indicating the length of the EPS bearer context status contents.

entities.name: EPS Bearer Identity bits
entities.description: Bits representing EPS Bearer Identities (EBI) from bit 0 to bit 15, indicating the state of corresponding EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: EPS bearer context
entities.description: A bearer context identified by an EPS bearer identity, whose state is indicated by the EPS bearer context status IE.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifier for an EPS bearer context, represented by bits in the EPS bearer context status IE.

relations.description: The EPS bearer context status IE contains the IEI field.
The EPS bearer context status IE contains the length field.
The EPS bearer context status IE contains the EBI bits field.
The EPS bearer context status IE indicates the state of EPS bearer contexts.
The EBI bits represent EPS bearer identities and their states.
